beats.quote: I just want her to come to me first.

beats.line: A horrible message in the group chat.

beats.me: She showed me a horrible message from a group chat. What do I say?

digi: Right now: say you are glad she showed you. Keep your face calm.
Next: ask who sent it and listen fully, before you decide anything.
Tonight: screenshot it together. Tell her the phone is not at risk for telling you.
